A '''town''' was located near the [[Canal District]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dubrava/Legends|Dubrava]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were stationed in the town, and many [[Dubravan]]s, such as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Sarma]], lived there.<ref name="Vader's Quest" />
